abstract: Pick and verify the tool-call parser for a model on each inference engine. Covers vLLM --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser, SGLang --tool-call-parser, TensorRT-LLM --tool_parser, llama.cpp --jinja templates, Ollama tools, TensorFold and TabbyAPI tool_format, with verified parser-name lists, a model-family-to-parser table, strict tool modes, a probe script and a tool-call success gate with rollback.
